label: TP
reason: User-controlled HTTP parameters flow directly to response.getWriter().format() without sanitization. The doSomething() method passes param unchanged to bar, then obj array includes bar which is interpolated via format() method. X-XSS-Protection header disabled (set to "0") removes browser-level protection.

evidence.note: param from user input flows through doSomething() to response.getWriter().format() without escaping
